build_world_graph: build a WorldGraph instance to model robot perception of rooms, furniture, objects, and agents as a directed acyclic graph
query_entities_in_graph: query all rooms, receptacles, furniture, or objects in the WorldGraph using get_all_rooms, get_all_furnitures, get_all_objects methods
find_closest_entities: find the n closest objects or furniture to a given entity or location within a distance threshold using get_closest_entities
update_world_graph: update the WorldGraph with a recent perception subgraph in ground truth mode using the update method with partial observability support
describe_world_state: generate a human-readable description of furniture layout and object locations in the house using get_world_descr method
